title: Twenty-nine flyers
logline: The Crab Derby: twenty-nine. The girl, sixteen, letters and draws and pins; and this year, at the page's edge, the tin of pins is on the counter with nobody holding it. She doesn't need it held.

panels.composition: The shingle wall with twenty-nine flyers and a sixteen-year-old pinning the newest, and on the counter's edge at the page's side a small tin of pushpins with nobody holding it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle wall with a row of twenty-nine crab flyers and a sixteen-year-old girl pinning the newest, a small tin of pushpins sitting alone on a counter's edge at the page's side, no words legible
image.notes: Compare ro_2022-02-11: the hand with the tin.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
